title: Custom Enchantments  Books
description: Enchantment books from residents for: Magnet, Bulldozer, Auto Melter, and Lava Walkers
body:
**📖✨ Custom Book Enchants**

Custom Book Enchants is a unique plugin that adds powerful custom enchantments through villager trades and gives players full control over enabling or disabling them in-game!

**✨ Main Features:**

* 📚 Adds custom enchantment books:

  * 🧲 Magnet
  * 🚜 Bulldozer
  * 🔥 Auto Smelt
  * 🌋 Lava Walker
* 🧑‍🌾 Custom villager trades for all enchant books
* 🎛️ Toggle enchantments ON/OFF anytime
* 🖱️ Shift + Right Click with a tool to open enchant menu
* ⚙️ Easy-to-use GUI for managing enchantments
* 💰 Fully configurable prices for trades
* 🎲 Set chance for trades to appear on villagers
* 🔧 Lightweight and optimized

**🎮 How It Works:**

* Get custom enchant books from villagers
* Apply them to your tools
* Hold your enchanted tool, look at a block, and press **Shift + Right Click**
* Open the menu and enable/disable enchantments anytime

**⚙️ Configuration:**
Everything can be customized in the config:

* 💰 Trade prices
* 🎲 Chance of enchant trades appearing
* 📚 Enable/disable specific enchantments
* 🧑‍🌾 Customize villager trades
* 🔄 Fully control plugin behavior

Perfect for survival servers that want more advanced mining mechanics and custom progression! 🚀
